messages:
alex (sales): hey @maria @devon — Nimbus Health wants a 2-week POC with a guaranteed dedicated window: 4xA100 pinned 10:00–14:00 PST Mon–Fri. Can we swap their current autoscale policy from burst to a scheduled guaranteed-min for that window? Also need scoped API keys limited to that pool and question on billing for reserved hours. cc @lin

maria (solutions): we can do scheduled policies. need pool id + exact dates + desired min/max. also clarify if they prefer 'guaranteed-min' or 'hard-reserve' semantics (hard-reserve blocks capacity vs guaranteed-min tries to keep available).

devon (infra): technically ok. we can set scheduled policy to min=4 max=8 for 10:00-14:00. please confirm pool name and date range. billing: scheduled reserved hours will bill as dedicated-hours at the reserved rate during the window. i'll open a provisioning ticket for the policy change once confirmed.

lin (eng-runtime): two notes: 1) forcing min=4 could increase queue latency for other pools if cluster tight — recommend fallback routing to hosted variants when queue length > 90s; 2) model quant/profile compatibility — if they're using a quantized variant that only runs on specific nodes, we need to ensure the pool has matching node labels.

alex (sales): confirmation: pool id = pool-nimbus-23. date range 2026-04-04 to 2026-04-18. desired window 10:00-14:00 PST Mon–Fri, min=4 max=8. They want latency SLOs so fallback to hosted is acceptable but must alert the POC team when fallback occurs. Also need instructions for scoped API keys so the customer cannot call other pools.

provisioning-bot: Provisioning request received for pool-nimbus-23. Ticket #PR-8423 created: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PR-8423. ETA for scheduled policy change: ~24 hours after approval.

sophie (finance): For POCs under 30 days we offer pro-rated reserved-hour billing at 75% of monthly reserved rate, no minimum commit. We will include a POC billing line item that is pre-approved by finance.

devon (infra): ok i'll queue the change and attach a canary fallback to hosted. one more thing: we need a scoped API key with tag `pool:pool-nimbus-23` and permissions `invoke,stream`. please supply a list of developer emails that need access and whether they need log access.

alex (sales): access list: alice.dev@nimhealth.com, bob.engineer@nimhealth.com, carla.cto@nimhealth.com. Logs should be readonly only for alice and bob. carla needs invoke only. also please rotate any existing keys tied to the trial and issue new scoped keys.

lin (eng-runtime): example fallback config we will apply (canary first):
```
autoscale_policy:
  scheduled_windows:
    - days: [Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri]
      start: "10:00"
      end: "14:00"
      min_replicas: 4
      max_replicas: 8
  fallback:
    target: hosted-compatible-variant
    trigger_queue_seconds: 90
    notify: ["alex (sales)", "alice.dev@nimhealth.com"]
```

maria (solutions): i'll prepare the order amendment and attach the POC pricing. will also add the scoped key step to the onboarding checklist.

alex (sales): perfect — i'll confirm dates with Nimbus and post the approvals here. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

provisioning-bot: Update: ticket PR-8423 approved by infra-leads. Scheduling change will run at 02:00 UTC tomorrow.

devon (infra): change applied. scheduled window set and scoped API key created: token-POC-nimbus-2026-04 (sent to carla via secure channel). log permissions set as requested. monitoring alerts configured for fallback notifications.

alex (sales): got it, forwarding token to customer and confirming demo schedule. will post any issues here.

maria (solutions): closing loop from solutions side — let me know if finance needs signature for amendment.

alex (sales): no signature needed per finance note, all good. thanks team! :rocket:
